title: THE STASH DOLL: IT FILLS ITS PANEL, THE KEY HINTS NO LONGER SIT ON THE PANELS, THE LIST STANDS IN GROUPS
why: seen on the first pictures of v37.43 and from the critic (score 3): the key hints drew over the bottom of the panels because a footer holding only the X measures 0, a third of the doll panel stood empty, the list read as one wall, nothing was the one main action
now: slots are taller and hold the icon over the name, the figure is larger, the hints have their own row under the panels, the list groups pieces by kind with a gap and its head reads stash n, save outfit is the one lime button, the verdict word is calmer, the tip panel reads pick a piece until something is picked
